title: It's All About the Employee Handbook
subtitle: Damning correspondence that details relentlessly ignored standards of safety in the hostile work environment of Mordor
text:
Subject: Witch King's Employee Handbook and Workplace Safety Compliance

From: Saruman To: Sauron Date: April 16, The Third Age

Dear Sauron,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inquire about Witch King's adherence to the Mordor Corporation Employee Handbook and our workplace safety policies and procedures. I have been unable to find any records indicating that the Witch King has signed the Employee Handbook acknowledgment form. Additionally, there have been concerns raised about his compliance with workplace safety policies.

Could you please clarify whether the Witch King is in compliance with our established policies and procedures? Your prompt attention to this matter would be greatly appreciated.

Sincerely, Saruman

Subject: RE: Witch King's Employee Handbook and Workplace Safety Compliance

From: Sauron To: Saruman Date: April 16, The Third Age

Dear Saruman,

Thank you for bringing this matter to my attention. I assure you that the Witch King is fully aware of his responsibilities and duties within the Mordor Corporation. Regarding the Employee Handbook acknowledgment form, I will personally ensure that the Witch King signs and returns it promptly.

As for the workplace safety concerns, I must remind you that our organization operates under unique circumstances, and while we strive to maintain a safe working environment, certain risks are inherent in our line of work. I would appreciate it if we could focus on the bigger picture rather than nitpicking individual cases.

Best regards, Sauron

Subject: RE: Witch King's Employee Handbook and Workplace Safety Compliance

From: Saruman To: Sauron Date: April 17, The Third Age

Dear Sauron,

While I understand the unique nature of our organization, it is crucial that we adhere to the policies and procedures outlined in the Employee Handbook to maintain a consistent and compliant working environment. Ensuring the Witch King's compliance is vital in setting an example for the rest of our employees.

Please keep me updated on the status of the Witch King's acknowledgment form and any steps taken to address the workplace safety concerns.

Sincerely, Saruman

Subject: RE: Witch King's Employee Handbook and Workplace Safety Compliance

From: Sauron To: Saruman Date: April 17, The Third Age

Dear Saruman,

I acknowledge your concerns, and as I mentioned before, I will ensure Mr. Witch King's compliance with the Employee Handbook.

However, I would like to remind you that creating an atmosphere of distrust and excessive scrutiny can lead to allegations of a hostile work environment, which is counterproductive to our organization's goals. It is essential that we support and trust each other to succeed in our mission. 100% compliance with a culture of excellence is a Mordor organization wide key result for The Third Age. I’m sure I don't have to remind you—this OKR implementation was your Personal Responsibility this year.

Best regards, Sauron

Subject: Concerns Regarding Recent Email Exchange between Saruman and Sauron

To: Saruman, Sauron, Senior Management, Compliance Department, Humanoid Resources Date: April 18, The Third Age

Dear Saruman, Sauron, and Colleagues,

I am writing to express my concerns regarding the recent email exchange between Saruman and Sauron discussing the Witch King's compliance with the Mordor Corporation Employee Handbook and workplace safety policies. As General Counsel for Mordor Corporation, it is my responsibility to ensure that our organization operates in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.

The tone and content of the email exchange have raised several concerns:

• The potential failure to adhere to company policies and procedures by high-ranking members of our organization, such as the Witch King, can have serious legal and regulatory consequences for Mordor Inc. These are critical failure Points.

• The focus on individual compliance rather than addressing potential systemic issues could be detrimental to the overall success and compliance of our organization.

• The suggestion that maintaining compliance and addressing potential violations may contribute to a perception of a hostile work environment is concerning and should not be dismissed.

In light of these concerns, I recommend the following actions:

• A thorough review of the compliance status of all senior management members, including the Witch King, to ensure adherence to the Employee Handbook and workplace safety policies.

• A comprehensive assessment of our organization's overall compliance with workplace safety regulations, addressing any potential systemic issues. I can’t emphasize too strongly how my prior experience with the Town of Dale incident informed this recommendation.

• Providing additional training for all employees, including senior management, on the importance of maintaining a professional and respectful work environment while ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements. This needs to include wraith and non-wraith staff. It is a compliance issue.

• Establishing a clear communication protocol to address compliance concerns, allowing for open and respectful dialogue between all parties involved. Let’s make sure the employees are made aware of communication opportunities at our next all claws?

Please consider this letter a formal request to address these concerns and implement the recommended actions.

It is crucial that we work together to ensure the integrity and success of our organization while maintaining a safe, compliant, and respectful work environment.

Sincerely,

Elrond, General Counsel

Mordor Inc.
